title: Hand-harvest labor per pound (hours)

source.name: Saffron harvesting labor reporting
source.publisher: agricultural/horticultural reporting on saffron harvest labor

notes: Saffron: commonly cited 40-70 hours of skilled hand-harvesting labor per pound (midpoint ~55 used here), since every crocus flower is hand-picked and hand-separated. Black pepper is a conservative estimate reflecting modern mechanized/semi-mechanized harvesting.
